improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
improve.coach: Steady at about 60% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: It's come up in 35% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one. 70% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu. Shows up in 50% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed. 50% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

coach.intro: BellyTb1, 20 matches is enough to see who you are as a player. I like what I see, and I see where we can go.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
